
{{alias}}( [arg[, byteOffset[, byteLength]]] )
    Returns a single-precision floating-point SGD parameters object.

    Parameters
    ----------
    arg: Object|ArrayBuffer (optional)
        ArrayBuffer or data object.

    byteOffset: integer (optional)
        Byte offset.

    byteLength: integer (optional)
        Maximum byte length.

    Returns
    -------
    out: Object
        Parameters object.

    Examples
    --------
    > var p = new {{alias}}();
    > p.toString()
    <string>

    See Also
    --------
